We recruited participants from Amazon Mechanical Turk to chat with the models. Participants were asked to compare the two models based on the following questions: (1) Fluency: which bot's responses were more fluent and understandable? (2) Identification: which bot explored your situation more in depth and was more helpful in identifying your problems? (3) Comforting: which bot was more skillful in comforting you? (4) Suggestion: which bot gave you more helpful suggestions for your problems? (5) Overall: generally, which bot's emotional support do you prefer?
